name: loop-gridzoomstrip
title: Loop Grid Zoom Strip
description: A 3x3 grid of image cards flies into a single strip and back. 9 image slots, 6s seamless loop, 1:1.
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Media · Fit
variables.description: Natural keeps each image's own ratio; Crop fills the card box at the media aspect below.

variables.label: Media · Aspect
variables.description: Card aspect used when Fit is Crop.

variables.label: Background · Type
variables.description: Gradient (start → end colours), flat Colour, or your own Image.

variables.label: Background · Gradient start
variables.description: Top colour of the gradient.

variables.label: Background · Gradient end
variables.description: Bottom colour of the gradient.

variables.label: Background · Color
variables.description: Flat colour when Type is Color; also the ground under an Image.

variables.label: Background · Image
variables.description: Cover-fitted background when Type is Image.

variables.label: Background · Blur
variables.description: Blur on the background image, px.

variables.label: Background · Grain
variables.description: Film-grain overlay strength.

variables.label: Background · Opacity
variables.description: Opacity of the whole background layer (0 = transparent ground).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow
variables.description: Shadow Enabled (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow X
variables.description: Shadow X (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow Y
variables.description: Shadow Y (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow blur
variables.description: Shadow Blur (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow spread
variables.description: Shadow Spread (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow opacity
variables.description: Shadow Opacity (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Shadow colour
variables.description: Shadow Color (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Appearance · Border radius
variables.description: Card corner radius in px at 1080.

variables.label: Animation · Easing
variables.description: Easing family for stepped motion.

variables.label: Animation · Ease Bezier
variables.description: Cubic-bezier control points for custom easing.

variables.label: Animation · Direction
variables.description: Direction of travel.

variables.label: Animation · Movement
variables.description: Movement (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Animation · Fade
variables.description: Fade (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Padding
variables.description: Padding (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Zoom
variables.description: Zoom (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Grid Gap
variables.description: Grid Gap (engine parameter; see the block header comment).

variables.label: Template options · Focus Mode
variables.description: Focus Mode (engine parameter; see the block header comment).
